home.title: Panel
home.placeholderTitle: This will be your command centre.
home.placeholderBody: The dashboard is waiting for data. Until then, most of the action is in orders.

emailSettings.title: Email settings
emailSettings.intro: The sender of messages to customers and invitees, plus delivery status. The sending address is shared across the platform — you personalize the display name and reply-to address.
emailSettings.transportAvailable: The system can send transactional messages.
emailSettings.senderMissing: Sender: not set — rental lifecycle messages will not go out until a name is set.
emailSettings.nameLabel: Sender name (shown in the From field)
emailSettings.replyToHint: Customer replies go to this address. Without it, replies return to the platform address.

emailLog.title: Message history
emailLog.intro: A record of every send attempt: what reached the customer, and what did not — with the reason.
emailLog.emptyForOrder: No messages have been sent for this order yet.
emailLog.previewFrameTitle: Content of the message sent to the customer
emailLog.previewSandboxNote: The preview shows the content as saved at the moment of sending. Links and scripts are disabled inside it.
emailLog.previewFailed: Could not load the message content.

contractSettings.title: Agreement settings
contractSettings.intro: Company details and versioned terms included in rental agreements.
contractSettings.readOnly: Only the organization owner can change these settings.
contractSettings.missing: Agreement settings have not been configured yet.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: We sent you an email with a confirmation link. Click it to finish signing up and create your organization.

authError.providerUnavailable: The sign-in service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.

security.scanHint: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g. Google Authenticator) or enter the secret manually:
security.enrollBody: Add an authenticator app to require a second step at sign-in.
security.secretOnceHint: We show the secret only during setup. Save it somewhere safe.

mfaChallenge.title: Confirm your identity
mfaChallenge.body: This section requires two-factor authentication. Enter the code from your authenticator app.

productForm.name: Name
productForm.moneyHint: Amount in major units, up to two decimal places, e.g. 100.50.
productForm.autoIncrementMultiplier: Daily multiplier beyond the highest tier
productForm.autoIncrementHint: Each day beyond the highest pricing tier costs base price × this multiplier. 1 = base price.

units.title: Units: {name}
units.empty: No units yet — the product cannot be handed out until it has at least one.
units.windowHint: Service window needs BOTH dates (from and to) or none. Same date on both = one-day service.

images.title: Photos: {name}
images.fileHint: Formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF. Up to 5 MB.
images.empty: No photos yet — add the first one to show this product in the store.

errors.missing: Choose an image file to upload.
errors.size: The image can be up to 5 MB.
errors.type: Allowed image formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF.
errors.denied: This photo cannot be uploaded to the selected product.
errors.upload: The photo could not be uploaded.
errors.content: The file is not a valid image in the selected format.
errors.finalize: The photo could not be added. Try again.

tiers.title: Pricing tiers: {name}
tiers.billingModelInfo: The shape of your tiers defines the billing model: a tier for every day means per-day billing, sparse tiers mean packages (e.g. “up to 7 days”). The preview below shows exactly what each rental length will cost.
tiers.emptyEditor: No tiers — every rental is billed at base price × number of days.
tiers.multiplierHint: The multiplier is the TOTAL price of the tier as a multiple of the daily base price — not a per-day multiplier. Days = 7, multiplier = 6.5, base 100 → the 7-day rental costs 650 in total. The tier price column shows the resulting amount.
tiers.previewIntro: Live calculation for each rental length, using the same pricing engine that will price orders.
tiers.previewSkippedRows: Rows skipped in the preview (incomplete or invalid): {count}.

emptyState.title: Empty warehouse. Add your first product.

contract.title: Rental agreement
contract.missingSettings: Complete the company details and agreement terms first.
contract.empty: No agreement has been generated yet.

invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.dialogRecipient: The message will go to the customer's address: {email}
invoice.noArchiveNote: We do not store the sent file — the history records that the invoice went out and to which address, but the document itself stays with you.
invoice.notSent: The invoice has not been sent yet.
invoice.sentSuccess: The invoice has been sent to the customer.
invoice.noCustomerEmail: This order has no customer email address — there is nowhere to send the invoice.

errors.missing: Choose an invoice file to send.
errors.type: The invoice must be a PDF file.
errors.size: The invoice may be at most {limit} MB.
errors.noCustomerEmail: This order has no customer email address — the invoice was not sent.

list.title: Orders
list.subtitle: Manage rentals and track payments
list.searchPlaceholder: Search by number, customer, company or status…
list.columnsFixedHint: ID and Actions are always visible.
list.selectAllOnPage: Select all orders on this page
list.bulkNoEmailHint: Bulk change does not send customer emails — send them from the order screen.

list.bulkResultNone: No order was changed — {count, plural, one {# order was} other {# orders were}} rejected.

notFound.title: This page left without a handover protocol.

form.previewTitle: Quote: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of rental
form.deliveryPricingMissing: Configure delivery pricing for this method in delivery settings before creating the order.

section.title: Delivery
section.pricingMissing: No delivery price list for this method.
section.notCourier: This order is not delivered by courier — shipments unavailable.
section.sendReturnLabelCta: Email the return label to the customer
section.returnLabelSentOk: Return label sent to the customer.
section.pickupReminderHint: Send the customer a reminder to return the equipment at the pickup location.
section.pickupReminderSentOk: Return reminder sent to the customer.
section.emailUnavailable: Email sending is unavailable — configure it to send messages.
section.modalDescription: Review the details, pick a carrier and create the shipment.
section.carriersHint: Gross prices from the provider. Cheapest selected.
section.noCarrierYet: Search carriers to see prices. Without a choice we create the shipment with the cheapest available.
section.insuranceHint: Declared value of the contents to insure.
section.saturdayHint: The parcel may also be delivered on Saturday (if the carrier offers it).

settings.title: Delivery settings
settings.intro: Courier and delivery pricing configuration for this account.
settings.pricingIntro: Amounts in PLN. Empty price = method without pricing (creating a shipment reports a configuration error). Empty threshold = no free delivery.
settings.secretWriteOnly: The secret is a write-only field. We never show a saved value again.
settings.accessRuleOwner: Every team member sees the operational data. Save buttons and the new password field belong to the owner only.
settings.accessRuleMember: You see the operational data in read mode. Delivery settings are changed by the organization owner.

detail.title: Order {number}
detail.cancelBlockedHint: Cancellation blocked — the payment must be settled (refunded) before cancelling.
detail.sendEmailUnavailable: Email sending is not configured — the customer will not be notified.
detail.emailPromptBody: The order status has been changed to “{status}”. Send the customer a message about this change?
detail.emailPromptUndoNote: The message goes out only after {seconds} s — you can cancel the send during that time.
detail.emailSkipped: No message was sent. The order status is changed.
detail.emailCountdown: The message to the customer goes out in {seconds} s.
detail.emailCountdownLeaveWarning: Do not close this tab or navigate away — leaving the page before the countdown ends aborts the send and the customer gets nothing.
detail.emailCancelled: Send cancelled — no message was sent.
detail.emailSent: The message has been sent to the customer.
detail.emailUnknown: The connection dropped and it is unclear whether the message went out — check the communication history below.

items.removeConfirm: Remove this item from the order?
items.empty: This order has no items yet.
items.addNoProducts: The catalogue has no active products — nothing to add.
items.addNoFreeWarning: This product has no free unit for the order term. The item will be added WITHOUT an assigned unit and flagged as such — assign a unit once one frees up.
items.addNoUnitsAtAll: This product has no units in stock at all. The item will be added WITHOUT an assigned unit and flagged as such.
items.depositCollectedNotice: The deposit has already been collected ({amount}). Changing this amount only changes the order's INTENDED deposit — it is not a refund or a top-up and writes nothing to the deposit ledger. Money goes back to the customer only through deposit settlement.
items.totalsDrift: Order totals do not match the items (from items: rental {rental}, deposit {deposit}). Save any item to recalculate them.
items.lockedPickedUp: The equipment is already handed over — items of a picked-up order are not edited. Adding equipment mid-rental goes on a separate order.
items.lockedClosed: The order is closed (returned or cancelled) — its items can no longer be changed.

deposit.title: Deposit
deposit.empty: No deposit events yet — record a collection to open the settlement.
deposit.refundOnlineHint: The refund is a real transfer back to the customer through the payment provider — the deposit was taken together with the rental payment.
deposit.refundManualHint: Records a refund made outside the system (cash, your own transfer).
deposit.refundInFlightBlocked: A refund for this order is awaiting confirmation from the provider — another one would pay the same deposit twice.
deposit.settleStaleBalance: The deposit balance changed after this dialog was opened — refresh the page and check the current balance before settling. Nothing has been saved.

refundStatus.requested: Refund requested — no provider response yet

deposit.trackOnline: The deposit is collected and refunded automatically through the payment provider.
deposit.trackManual: Manual track — the operator records the collection and the refund (cash, own transfer).
deposit.awaitingAutoCollect: The deposit will be collected automatically once the provider confirms the payment.
deposit.refundNotePlaceholder: e.g. equipment returned complete and undamaged
deposit.summaryPaidOutManual: To hand back to the customer

extension.title: Rental extension
extension.pickDateHint: Pick a date after the current rental end to see the surcharge.

notes.label: Notes (equipment condition, deposit remarks)
notes.placeholder: e.g. deposit reduced by 50 for a scratched cable…

site.subtitle: Arrange sections, pick a template and publish the page your customers see.
site.loadError: Could not load the storefront page. Refresh to try again.

sections.heading: Page sections
sections.addHint: A new section is appended at the end of the page.
sections.empty: No sections yet. Add the first one to build your page.

domainSettings.title: Store domains
domainSettings.intro: The addresses your store runs on. A subdomain on our domain is created automatically with your organisation. You can add your own domain below — it requires one DNS record at your registrar.
domainSettings.registrationUnavailable: Added addresses will not start working until the configuration is completed.
domainSettings.emptyState: You do not have a store address yet. A subdomain is created together with your organisation — if it is missing, create and register it below.
domainSettings.retryOk: Address registered — your store is live at it.
domainSettings.retryContactFallback: If it happens again on the next attempt, get in touch.
domainSettings.kindSubdomain: Platform subdomain — works immediately, no DNS setup needed.
domainSettings.kindCustom: Custom domain — works once the DNS record is confirmed.
domainSettings.dnsHeading: Record to add at your registrar
domainSettings.dnsIntro: Add this record in your domain's DNS panel. We cannot do this step for you — only you have access to your DNS.
domainSettings.dnsPropagation: DNS changes usually appear within minutes, sometimes hours. Then click “Check verification”.
domainSettings.verifiedOk: Domain verified — your store is live at this address.
domainSettings.stillPending: The domain is not verified yet.
domainSettings.domainHint: The host name only, without http:// and without a path.
domainSettings.addedOk: Domain added. Add the DNS record, then click “Check verification”.
domainSettings.providerAvailable: Store addresses can be registered and retried.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Organization details shown on documents and in billing.
organization.name: Name
organization.readOnly: This screen is read-only. Avably support applies changes to organization data.

paymentSettings.title: Payments
paymentSettings.intro: Online payments in your store are handled by an external provider. You open an account there, pass verification, and your customers' money goes straight to your account — we only act as an intermediary.

stageHint.missing: You do not have a payment account yet. Without one, the store offers bank transfer and payment on delivery only.
stageHint.pending: The account exists, but the provider has not cleared it to accept payments yet.
stageHint.payouts_blocked: The account accepts payments, but payouts are on hold — the money stays with the provider until you unblock it.
stageHint.ready: The account accepts payments and pays out funds.

paymentSettings.refreshOk: Account state read from the provider.
paymentSettings.refreshFailed: Could not read the account state:
paymentSettings.unavailable: Online payments are unavailable right now:
paymentSettings.ownerOnly: Only the organisation owner can connect a payment account.
paymentSettings.requirementsHint: The names come from the provider — you fill them in on their form via “Finish verification”.
